_comment: Modules under src/ that export symbols but have no production importer. Every entry must carry a reason: the checker only requires the key to exist, so the reason is what makes it reviewable. Delete an entry the moment the module gains an importer - the checker prints '! allowlist entry no longer matches an orphan' when it does. Keys starting with _ are documentation, not entries.
_schema: relative path -> reason it is still unreachable
src/lib/specQueue.ts: Verifies an OpenSpec change queue at OPENSPEC_CHANGES_DIR (default <root>/openspec/changes). This repo has no openspec/ directory, so wiring it into the loop would report 'no specs' forever. Kept because the env var makes it usable the moment OpenSpec is adopted, and it has a real test (tests/spec-queue.test.ts).
src/lib/recourseSdk.ts: A published SDK surface, advertised in README.md:83-84. It is for EXTERNAL consumers, so having no in-repo importer is correct by design; there is no CLI that uses it. Revisit if the README claim is withdrawn.
src/lib/v5/proofLadder.ts: SMT component verification. NOT WIRED DELIBERATELY: the encoders at proofLadder.ts:111-115, :247 and :284-289 fall through to `(assert false)` for anything outside three hardcoded cases, and `unsat` is read as 'entailed' - so a program with no relation to its inputs would be reported as PROVED. Wiring it would add a silent-pass generator to /v5/synthesize. Fix the encoders first.
src/lib/v5/sygus.ts: SyGuS-v2 candidate proposer for /v5/synthesize. NOT WIRED DELIBERATELY: `differentialCheck` (sygus.ts:317-328) computes cvc5's output and then `return { agree: true }` without comparing anything, so there is currently no mechanism that could reject a bad candidate. There is also no test. Fix the oracle before wiring.
src/lib/v5LockWriter.ts: Writes and SIGNS v5 index-lock entries. The product validates lock entry SCHEMA at /v5/lock/validate but never writes one, so a schema-valid entry passes today without ever having been signed. Wiring the signature check needs a secret-distribution decision (where the HMAC key lives) that has not been made.
